title: AI Agent Plan & Prompt Sanitizer
target_pain: Reviewing and feeding raw, bloated coding agent plans (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex) and incident logs into LLMs risks leaking API keys, wasting token context limits, and struggling with unreadable formatting.
key_features: Automatic Secret & PII Redaction (OpenAI Keys, AWS Creds, JWTs, Bearer Tokens, Emails)
Agent Log & Plan Bloat Cleaner (Strips line numbers, timestamps, system headers)
Real-time Token & Character Cost Estimator with Savings Calculator
Duplicate Line & Whitespace De-noiser for LLM Context Window Optimization
One-click Raw/Cleaned Export with Local Storage Usage Tracking & Paywall Logic
